title: Gold Plus Saver Account: Withdrawal limits
summary: This document explains the Gold Plus Saver Account monthly withdrawal allowance: up to 30 withdrawals per monthly cycle, counting outbound movements including electronic transfers, outgoing wires, and internal transfers to other Rho-Bank accounts owned by your business. It also covers what counts toward the limit and what to do if you exceed it.
faqs: How many withdrawals can I make from my Gold Plus Saver Account each monthly cycle?
What types of transactions count toward the 30-withdrawal limit (transfers, wires, internal transfers)?
Do internal transfers to other Rho-Bank accounts owned by my business count toward the limit?
What happens if I try to make more than 30 withdrawals in a month?
How can I manage or reduce the number of withdrawals to avoid hitting the limit?
Where can I monitor my remaining withdrawal count? (account dashboard)
